programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Robin ventures into the forest in search of ancient secrets, Zoro takes to the water for a slicing, dicing showdown with Hordy Jones, and Luffy is branded a royal kidnapper by an angry mob of fish folk!
programme.sub-title: Keep Shirahoshi safe! Decken close behind!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy, Chopper, and Sanji are taken prisoner by a fish mob just as Vander Decken launches an attack the princess! Elsewhere, Zoro continues his battle with Hordy, and Nami hitches a ride on a mermaid to escape the crumbling palace!
programme.sub-title: The Straw Hats defeated?! Hordy gains control of the Ryugu Palace!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro and Neptune fight bravely, but they're no match for Hordy and his pill-popping minions. Back at the ship, Luffy reunites with Jimbei, who reveals something sinister about his past.
programme.sub-title: The haunting ties! Nami and the Fishman Pirates!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The New Fish-Man Pirates continue their bloody and violent uprising, and Jimbei begins the story of how he unleashed the monster known as Arlong on the unsuspecting citizens of the East Blue.
programme.sub-title: A hero who freed the slaves! An adventurer Tiger!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Jimbei continues his story with tales of fish-men taken as slaves, Queen Otohime's fierce devotion to her people, the legend of Fisher Tiger, and the sinister rise of Arlong.
programme.sub-title: KIZARU APPEARS! A TRAP TO CATCH TIGER!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Arlong's violent tendencies are condemned by Fisher Tiger, and the arrival of a young human girl teaches the Fish-Man Pirates a lesson in compassion.
programme.sub-title: A Team is Formed! Save Chopper

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The great pirate Fisher Tiger keeps his promise to a young slave girl, but the adults in her village are determined to make him pay for his act of honor.
programme.sub-title: THE DEATH OF THE HERO! A SHOCKING TRUTH OF TIGER!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: In the wake of Fisher Tiger's tragic death, the once-mighty Sun Pirates are splintered by an ongoing quarrel between Jimbei and Arlong. Meanwhile, Queen Otohime's ceasless quest to help her people begins to take its toll.
programme.sub-title: THE SUN PIRATES SPLIT! JIMBEI VS. ARLONG!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Tensions run high when a slave-owning Celestial Dragon washes up on Fish-Man Island. His former captives cry for out for blood, but Queen Otohime sees it as a chance to mend fences between the gilled and non-gilled!
programme.sub-title: SHAKING FISHMAN ISLAND! A CELESTIAL DRAGON DRIFTS IN!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: After an agonizing absence, Queen Otohime returns to her people with exciting news. Unfortunately, a horrific act of violence derails the queen's mission and changes life on Fish-Man Island forever.
programme.sub-title: A SUDDEN TRAGEDY! A GUNSHOT SHUTS DOWN THE FUTURE!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Jimbei reaches the heartbreaking conclusion in the story of Queen Otohime, Nami does something completely unexpected, and Hordy Jones makes a foreboding appearance!
programme.sub-title: BACK TO THE PRESENT! HORDY MAKES A MOVE!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Hordy announces his sinister plans for Fish-Man Island. Luffy and Shirahoshi are ready to fight, but Jimbei wants to wage this war on his own!
programme.sub-title: THE KINGDOM IN SHOCK! AN ORDER TO EXECUTE NEPTUNE ISSUED!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and Jimbei come to blows over how to handle Hordy's uprising. Back at the palace, Brook embarks on an out-of-body experience with hopes of saving his mates!
programme.sub-title: A RIFT OPENS UP! LUFFY VS. JIMBEI!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Jimbei and Luffy continue their standoff, the New Fish-Man pirates go on a rampage, and Hordy begins to experience startling side effects from his pill-popping habit!
programme.sub-title: SOMETHING HAS HAPPENED TO HORDY! THE TRUE POWER OF THE EVIL DRUG!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Hordy's rampant use of the energy steroid makes him bigger, stronger, and scarier than ever before! The Fish-Man princes join the battle, but even they may not be strong enough to stop Hordy's onslaught!
programme.sub-title: THE BATTLE IS ON! AT CONCHCORDE PLAZA!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Jimbei and Shirahoshi are captured by the enemy, and Hordy makes a shocking revelation to the population of Fish-Man Island!
programme.sub-title: A SURPRISING CONFESSION! THE TRUTH BEHIND THE ASSASSINATION OF OTOHIME!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Shirahoshi reveals that she knew the truth about her mother's murder all along, and Luffy makes a bone-crushing entrance when the princess needs him most!
programme.sub-title: SHIRAHOSHI'S TEARS! LUFFY FINALLY SHOWS UP!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Hordy announces his plan for turning humans into slaves, the people of Fish-Man Island throw their support behind a new champion, and Luffy amazes even his own friends!
programme.sub-title: A BIG CLASH! THE STRAW HATS VS. A HUNDRED THOUSAND ENEMIES!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and the gang show off how much stronger they've become by issuing a brutal beat down to Hordy and his ferocious Fish-Man Pirates! Can anything stop the Hats?
programme.sub-title: DEADLY ATTACKS ONE AFTER ANOTHER! ZORO AND SANJI JOIN THE BATTLE!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Hordy's men keep attacking, but the Straw Hats have new weapons at their disposal! Franky unleashes the fury of the Black Rhino, and Luffy turns the tables on Hordy with a little help from his Kraken!
programme.sub-title: UNVEILED! THE SECRET WEAPONS OF THE SUNNY!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Franky dazzles Usopp and Chopper by transforming into a gigantic fighting robot, Hordy tries to blackmail the Kraken, and Luffy introduces his fist to the Fish-man's face!
programme.sub-title: IRON PIRATE! HERE COMES GENERAL FRANKY!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy shows off even more new powers as he brutally pummels Hordy, but the main attraction proves to be an ancient and immense pirate ship that's heading straight for Fish-Man Island!
programme.sub-title: THE NOAH CLOSING IN! THE FISHMAN ISLAND FACING DESTRUCTION!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Shirahoshi summons the courage to risk everything to save her world, Luffy puts his own life in peril by venturing into the ocean, and Hordy's devious nature fully comes to the surface.
programme.sub-title: HURRY UP, LUFFY! SHIRAHOSHI'S LIFE IN JEOPARDY!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy sets the stage for a final battle with Hordy, Sanji kicks a giant in defense of Nami's honor, and Zoro puts his blades to the ultimate test against a steroid-powered fighting fish!
programme.sub-title: THE FIERCE FIGHT BEGINS! LUFFY VS. HORDY!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While Luffy and Shirahoshi try to prevent Fish-Man Island from being crushed, the rest of the Straw Hats square off against the meanest Fish-Man Pirates in the deep blue sea!
programme.sub-title: A MASSIVE CONFUSED FIGHT! THE STRAW HATS VS. THE NEW FISHMAN PIRATES!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy is the only one who can stop Hordy, but he'll need air to survive the fight, so Shirahoshi's big brother risks his own life in a heroic attempt to get Luffy a bigger bubble!
programme.sub-title: LUFFY LOSES THE FIGHT?! HORDY'S LONG-AWAITED REVENGE!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While the rest of the Straw Hats continue to fight bravely, Luffy tries to find a way to save the island, and the horrible truth about Hordy's hatred for humans is finally revealed!
programme.sub-title: A SHOCKING FACT! THE TRUE IDENTITY OF HORDY!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Hordy's twisted past takes center stage in a Fish-Man flashback. Meanwhile, Shirahoshi's brother begs Luffy to save his beloved homeland and wipe out the anti-human element!
programme.sub-title: BACK TO ZERO! EARNEST WISHES FOR LUFFY!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy's fist of fire puts Hordy down for the count, and the rest of the Straw Hats try to make short work of the remaining Fish-Man Pirates. Meanwhile, a very big boat looms overhead!
programme.sub-title: LUFFY'S ALL-OUT ATTACK! RED HAWK BLASTS!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While the rest of the Straw Hats try to make short work of their enemies, Luffy summons the strength for one last brutal attack on Hordy. Now, about that giant boat…
programme.sub-title: COMING TO AN END! THE FINAL DECISIVE BATTLE AGAINST HORDY!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: After defeating Hordy, Luffy turns his attention to stopping the Noah from crushing Fish-Man Island. Straw Hats and Fish-Men alike watch as Luffy tries to obliterate a boat with a barrage of brutal blows!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Fish-Man Island was saved by the timely arrival of the Sea Kings, but all is not well. Luffy lost a lot of blood in his battle with Hordy, and fish-to-human transfusions are strictly forbidden!
programme.sub-title: TO THE FUTURE! THE PATH TO THE SUN!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Jimbei must decide whether or not to join the Straw Hats, and the grateful citizens of Fish-Man Island host a fabulous banquet in honor of their human heroes!
programme.sub-title: THE SECRET REVEALED! THE TRUTH ABOUT THE ANCIENT WEAPON!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and his crew learn of epic battle between Aokiji and Akainu, a forgotten foe tries to kidnap the mermaid princess, and Hordy's gang finally gets what's coming to them!
programme.sub-title: THE STRAW HATS STUNNED! THE NEW FLEET ADMIRAL OF THE NAVY!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Oh, no! Dora left her music homework in Boots' room. It's a song in English and Spanish, and she needs Boots to bring it to her school so she can sing it to the class.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's baby brother and sister just love bananas, but they also love stories! So Dora tells them a Super Babies story! The Super Babies have to get their bananas back from that Super Villain Swiper the Fox.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and all her friends are at the Super Adventure Race! To win the race, they have to make it across the Troll's tricky Bridge, past the Volcano filled with gooey balls, over the giant wall, and all the way to the finish line.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: It's summertime, and Dora and Boots are having a blast at the beach. But suddenly, they encounter the strangest sight - a snowman in Summer? What's wrong with this picture? Oh, no!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are hiking on Rainbow Rock when they come across a shy rainbow, Arco Iris, hiding behind a waterfall.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are having a blast at the beach when all of a sudden they hear a call for help. It's a baby crab stuck in a net!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are playing catch when they discover a lost Baby Fox. And he wants his mommy! Just then, Swiper shows up to swipe Boots' superball.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's twin brother and sister have been sick and she wants to buy them a present to cheer them up. Way up on a toy store shelf, she finds a dusty Jack-in-the-Box.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: It's Twins Day and everyone's getting ready for the big Twins Day Party at Play Park! Dora even has a surprise for her puppy Perrito. He has a twin too -- a long-lost puppy brother he hasn't seen since they were babies.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: "Happy Three Kings Day!" Dora, Boots, and Diego are dressed up as kings for the big Three Kings Day party. They'll be bringing a horse, a camel, and an elephant to carry the presents, and treats for the party, but Swiper scares the animals away!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Isa are planting Isa's special unicorn flowers when suddenly a baby unicorn, Unicornio, rides in on a Rainbow. He's thrilled to see Isa's beautiful flowers because they're his Mami's favorite.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Benny is so excited – it's his first time in the Big Go-Cart Race, where everyone races in homemade go-carts! But when the whistle blows, Benny's cart backfires and falls to pieces. But Dora and Boots won't let him give up.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boots and Tico are really excited because it's their first day of school ever -- and in their new school, they'll learn in English and Spanish!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Backpack, Backpack, yeah!!! Today's the Backpack Parade, where everyone dresses up their backpacks in different costumes. Backpack is super excited 'cause this year she gets to lead the parade with her song.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: "Special delivery for Boots the monkey!" Boots' favorite boots are back from the Shoe Shop, but when he tries them on, he starts to bounce, bounce, bounce. These aren't his boots -- these are bouncy boots.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora reads us a Mayan story about twin brothers who were amazing ballplayers. A long time ago in a Mayan Kingdom, there was a big Ball Game Championship.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are reading their favorite story, "The Three Little Pigs" when suddenly we hear the Piggies calling out for help. Their brick house is missing some bricks and the Big Bad Wolf is going to blow it down!
programme.sub-title: Dora Saves the Three Little Piggies

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: ABRACADABRA! The Big Red Chicken's putting on a magic show for all of his friends. With an "abracadabra," he pulls a rabbit out of his hat, but when it's time to make the bunny disappear, it doesn't work!
programme.sub-title: The Big Red Chicken's Magic Show

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: It's Junk Day and Benny's showing Dora and Boots his wagon of cool junk. But when the junk truck accidentally takes Backpack and Map off to the junkyard, it's up to Dora, Boots, Benny and his wagon of stuff to rescue them!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: It's naptime for the twins and Dora has a special Super Babies naptime story. Once upon a time, the Super Babies were getting ready for their nap but the Dream Fairy never showed up because she was still asleep!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Pirate Piggy really wants to be in the big Pirate Treasure Hunt, but his Piggies got tummyaches. He needs at least 3 mates to help him find the sunken treasure. Dora, Boots, and L'il Piggy will be his pirate mates -- yay!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora reads a story about a Wizzle who could grant wishes with his magic wand. On his birthday, it's his turn to make a wish but the wand gets blown away by the wind. Dora needs your help to save the Wizzle's magic wand!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are at an amusement park where they have a special wishing machine. Boots makes a wish: "I wish that when I say, 'bananas,' I get bananas." With a "boing," a bunch of bananas falls down on Boots.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots hop on Pegaso, the flying horse constellation, for a high-flying adventure to bring home his constellation friends to the Moon before the Sun rises!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Happy Birthday, Super Babies!: It's the Twins' 1st birthday and Dora reads them a very special Super Babies story. Once upon a time, there was a Cake-snatching Bear who stole all the cakes from the birthday boys and girls.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boots really wants to give his mommy a picture of himself for her birthday, but he's having a really bad hair day! Dora and Boots set out on a Hairy Quest: Boots is ready for his close-up!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots find a lovable little space creature named Winky. He came to visit with his family, our Purple Planet friends. But, uh oh, he's lost. We have to get Baby Winky back to his family before their spaceship takes off!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Grumpy Old Troll's getting married to Petunia and we all get to be a part of this wedding! Everything's almost ready, except the Grumpy Old Troll forgot to pick up the rings from his Grandma's House! Will we make it in time for the wedding?!
programme.sub-title: The Grumpy Old Troll Gets Married

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are going on vacation with Diego and Baby Jaguar at the Rainforest Campground. They're packing everything they need, especially Baby Jaguar's favorite, the Dora Snacks!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Big Red Chicken's doing magic tricks for us today! For his first trick, he turns Boots into a chicken! But when he's going to turn him back into a monkey, he lets out a big sneeze that sends the wand flying off into Magic Land where it breaks!
programme.sub-title: The Big Red Chicken's Magic Wand

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are headed to a brand new playground just over the Troll Bridge. When Dora and Boots get to the Bridge, they see that the Grumpy Old Troll's missing! Map tells us that the Troll is stuck in a magic Hole!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's dance class is having a big show for all of their friends and family. Dora's starting the show and she can't wait for her family to see her dance!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are heading to the Bike Shop to pick up Boots' very first bike today.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's helping her new friend, Pepe the Pig, learn all about his new school. Pepe's really excited, especially when he hears that if the class earns 3 gold stars today, they get a popcorn party!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Diego Save Atlantis: Dora, Boots, and King Unicornio leave Enchanted Forest to join Diego in making the lost continent of Atlantis rise by ending an ancient feud between unicorns and dragons!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora, Boots, and King Unicornio leave Enchanted Forest to join Diego in making the lost continent of Atlantis rise by ending an ancient feud between unicorns and dragons!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: DNA is Thicker than Water: Darius comes down hard on the Darks and places the blame squarely on Dark Leo's spiky shoulders. To prove that he is an apt leader Dark Leo devises a plan to destroy the Turtles from within.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Cosmic Completist: Raphael has contempt for Michelangelo's geeky toy collection, but when the leader of the Inawashi Gunjin comes to the Turtles for help with a malevolent alien, Raphael must think like a geek to beat Aramzedo, the ultimate collector!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Day of Awakening: When the entire population of Moonbase Bishop goes missing, it appears that Sh'Okanabo has jump started his plan to take over the Earth.The Turtles stage an assault on the base, only to find a bigger, badder Sh'Okanabo!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Zixxth Sense: Torbin Zixx convinces the Turtles to help him recover an experimental matter transmitter that he was forced to give to Boss Zukko to pay off a debt. The fate of the world may rest on the success of their mission. But can they trust Zixx?

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Tempus Fugit: When the Time Window is finally repaired, the Turtles enter into it to head home, but instead of finding themselves back in the lair, our heroes find themselves with Viral!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Karate Schooled: When the turtles are reunited with Casey and April, it's smiles all around … until it becomes clear that Casey's being brainwashed by his new martial arts instructor, Master Khan, a devoted Foot operative.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Something Wicked: The turtles' journey into cyberspace as Cybernauts on a mission to save as much of Master Splinter as they can find. But, they find far more than they're ready for. The Shredder! Born again. Inside the digital realm.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Engagement Ring: Casey and Raph head to Chinatown to find an engagement ring for April. They find one, all right. Too bad it has dark, transformational powers. Powers that are of interest to Hun and the Purple Dragons as well…

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Hacking Stockman: While Don focuses on collecting Splinter's data bits, his brothers find themselves pulled into a war between The Foot and the Purple Dragons. But things get a lot worse when the cyber-Shredder finds a way out of the digital realm!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Incredible Shrinking Serling: Desperate to get back to his own time, Serling builds a makeshift Time Window for himself. But when he's zapped to the NYC sewers to Turtle Tot time it's his worst nightmare as they tap him as their favorite new toy.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Identity Crisis: Cyber Shredder unleashes a virus that wipes the turtles memories out... reprogramming them so that they work for the Foot! The turtles do the bidding of Master Khan while April, Casey and Serling must work together to save our heroes.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Web Wranglers: When the Cyber Shredder creates a web portal that will allow him to venture from cyberspace into the real world, he first tests the device by releasing all sorts of mutants and monsters from various online programs.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: SuperQuest: The good news is the Turtles have found more of Splinter's lost data bits! The bad news is they're imbedded within the interface of Mikey's favorite online video game, SuperQuest!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Virtual Reality Check: The turtles leave Cyberspace to find everything very … normal. But, as this normalcy starts to unravel, the turtles realize they're still in Cyberspace, and the Shredder is tricking them.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: City Under Siege: With the Foot reassembled and his powers greater than ever, the Shredder hacks into the NYC computer grid and brings the city to its knees! The Turtles take to the rooftops to stop him!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Super Power Struggle: When Raph gets hold of a cape that grants him super powers, an impressed Justice Force invites him into their ranks and Mikey gets super jealous.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Wedding Bells and Bytes: With Master Splinter rescued, it's time to celebrate - and what better way than by having a wedding! So, at Casey's Grandma's farmhouse, the Turtles and Master Splinter prepare for April and Casey's long-awaited nuptials.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Rise of the Turtles Part 1: When Splinter allows his teenage sons, the Mutant Ninja Turtles, to visit the surface for the first time, they discover that the surface world isn't as simple as it first appears.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Rise of the Turtles Part 2: When Splinter allows his teenage sons, the Mutant Ninja Turtles, to visit the surface for the first time, they discover that the surface world isn't as simple as it first appears.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: New Friend, Old Enemy: To prove that Turtles can be friends with humans, Michelangelo uses a social networking site to befriend Chris Bradford, a famous martial artist who is secretly Shredder's top lieutenant.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: I Think His Name is Baxter Stockman: When the Turtles sneak out against Splinter's wishes, they battle Baxter Stockman, a deranged inventor in mechanical battle armor.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Metalhead: Weary of using his simple bo staff to fight the technologically advanced Kraang, Donatello creates Metalhead, a remote-controlled robot turtle to fight in his place.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Monkey Brains: Donatello and April investigate a scientist's disappearance, but discover a conspiracy regarding a bizarre psychic monkey instead.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Never Say Xever: Leo fears his act of mercy has come back to haunt him when Xever holds a local noodle shop owner hostage.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Gauntlet: After April receives a warning from her imprisoned father, she and the Turtles embark on a mission to save him and stop the Kraang from detonating a mutagen bomb in the city.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Panic in the Sewers: The Turtles must defend their home in the sewers when Bradford tries to destroy it with a dangerous chemical.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Mousers Attack!: When simultaneous threats from the Purple Dragons and Baxter Stockman's mechanical Mousers force the Turtles to split into two groups, Donnie & Mikey must prove that their "B Team" is just as valuable as Leo & Raph's "A Team."

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: It Came From the Depths: Michelangelo befriends an unstable mutant alligator who possesses a strange piece of Kraang technology, but the other Turtles aren't sure whether Leatherhead is a friend or a foe.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: New Girl In Town: Leonardo, tired of Raphael's constant criticism, lets his brother try his hand at leadership for a while. Meanwhile, Leonardo meets a beautiful and dangerous female ninja who tries to lure Leonardo to the dark side.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: I, Monster: The Turtles must face off against a new enemy, The Rat King, who threatens not only to take control of the city, but Splinter's mind as well.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Alien Agenda: The Turtles get their first taste of high school when April's school project draws Kraang attention.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Pulverizer: The Turtles meet their first fanboy when a teenage wannabe hero decides to fight crime and dress up as "The Pulverizer."

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: TCRI: While breaking into the hostile environment of TCRI headquarters, the Turtles discover the true intent of the Kraang and resolve to stop the alien invasion once and for all.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Cockroach Terminator: As the Turtles try to foil a Kraang invasion plot, they are hunted by a giant, indestructible cockroach.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Baxter's Gambit: Fed up with being humiliated by Fishface and Dogpound and defeated by the Turtles, Baxter Stockman seeks revenge by luring both parties into a deadly labyrinth.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Enemy of My Enemy: After witnessing the Kraang in action, Karai realizes the seriousness of the alien threat and approaches the Turtles to propose an alliance.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'ennemi de mon ennemi
programme.desc: Après avoir vu les Krangs à l'œuvre, Karai propose une alliance aux tortues. Mais est-elle digne de confiance ?

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La mission de Karaï
programme.desc: Le clan des Foot tente de capturer April, qui doit combattre Karaï si elle veut leur échapper.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le retour du Pulvériseur
programme.desc: Quand Shredder projette de créer une armée de mutants, les tortues demandent l'aide de leur plus grand fan.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'œuf
programme.desc: Leonardo, Raphael et Donatello deviennent les esclaves d'une guêpe mutante. Leur sort dépend de leur frère Michelangelo.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Une évasion à haut risque
programme.desc: April reçoit un message codé. Pendant que ses frères dorment, Donatello tente de le déchiffrer. C'est Kirby O'Neil, le père d'April, qui appelle à l'aide...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'affrontement, 1ère partie
programme.desc: Les Krangs s'apprêtent à lancer la phase finale de l'invasion de la Terre. Ils préparent l'arrivée du Technodrome depuis la dimension X, qui se fera par le portail.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'affrontement, 2e partie
programme.desc: Leonardo a survécu à l'explosion du dernier étage du TCRI, mais n'a pu empêcher le passage du Technodrome par le portail. L'immense vaisseau en forme de sphère sème la terreur sur la ville, en tirant à vue et enlevant des humains...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mutation accidentelle
programme.desc: C'est la fête chez les Tortues Ninja, mais malheureusement, ça ne va pas durer longtemps ! Les tortues ont répandu accidentellement une cargaison de tubes de mutagène au-dessus de la ville.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Qui est le chef ?
programme.desc: Les tortues parcourent la ville à la recherche des tubes de mutagène grâce au détecteur de fluides de Donnie. Karai repère leur manège et décide de leur tendre un piège...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion des écureuils-mutants
programme.desc: Tandis qu'elles parcourent la ville à la recherche de tubes de mutagène, les tortues tombent sur un sans-abri au comportement étrange. Il est aux prises avec un écureuil très agressif, qui finit par se faufiler dans son estomac...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mutagène-man se déchaîne
programme.desc: Pendant que ses frères regardent un dessin animé débile sur une vieille cassette vidéo, Donatello se confie à Timothy, transformé en mutant et conservé dans un tube dans son labo.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'acné mutante de Mikey
programme.desc: Un beau matin, Mikey se réveille avec des boutons sur tout le corps, ou presque. Pris de panique, il va voir ses frères qui tentent de le rassurer. En retour, il avoue avoir saupoudré un dérivé de mutagène sur sa peau pour devenir plus cool...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Une cible nommée April O'Neil
programme.desc: Shredder a eu vent du comportement de Karaï durant son absence et lui ordonne de ne plus s'allier aux Krangs. Mais ces derniers ont fabriqué le successeur des Foot-bots, et Karaï veut absolument se le procurer afin d'éliminer April...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Slash la tortue
programme.desc: Raphael s'agace. Il n'en peut plus d'avoir des frères qui passent leur temps à plaisanter et à jouer, ou à faire des gaffes. Cette fois, l'une des expériences de Donnie tourne mal, et Spike manque d'y laisser sa carapace...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La conspiration des Krangs
programme.desc: Pendant leur entraînement quotidien, les tortues et April se sentent observées. Elles poursuivent l'espion jusqu'à sa cachette, afin de le démasquer. Il s'agit d'un dénommé Kurtzman, journaliste de son métier, qui enquête sur la conspiration des Krangs.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le bon, la brute et Casey Jones
programme.desc: Après s'être disputé avec ses frères, Raphael va prendre l'air pour évacuer sa colère.
programme.sub-title: Le bon, la brute et Casey Jones

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Fungus Monstruosus
programme.desc: Les tortues ninja découvrent d'étranges champignons dans les égoûts de New York. Ce sont des champignons mutants, qui ont avalé du mutagène.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête d'acier Version 2.0
programme.desc: Donatello pense avoir réparé et amélioré Tête d'Acier, mais le robot continue d'avoir des bugs.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Des rats et des hommes
programme.desc: Le Roi des Rats a créé un sérum de croissance au mutagène qu'il a injecté à ses rats. Ceux-ci enlèvent des humains, destinés à devenir une armée d'hommes-rats. Casey et Irma, une amie d'April, sont kidnappés et enfermés dans des cages dans les égoûts

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tremblement de ver ! - Partie 1
programme.desc: Tandis que les tortues combattent Karaï et les Foot, Leonardo tente de révéler à Karaï la vraie identité de son père, mais en vain. La terre tremble, et elle en profite pour s'éclipser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tremblement de ver ! - Partie 2
programme.desc: Tandis que les tortues combattent Karaï et les Foot, Leonardo tente de révéler à Karaï la vraie identité de son père, mais en vain. La terre tremble, et elle en profite pour s'éclipser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les mutants du labyrinthe
programme.desc: Les quatre frères se passionnent pour un jeu de rôles, et décident de se déguiser pour faire une partie « grandeur nature » dans les égoûts.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La triste mutation de Baxter Stockman
programme.desc: Shredder met sa menace à exécution et fait exploser le collier de mutagène de Baxter Stockman, toujours incapable de lui fournir une armée de mutants digne de ce nom. Stockman mute en mouche et devient Stockman la mouche.
programme.sub-title: La triste mutation de Baxter Stockman

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le retour du Tritonateur
programme.desc: Raph trouve que son partenaire Casey n'est pas à la hauteur. De mystérieux justiciers éliminent les Krangs : il s'agit de Slash, l'ex-tortue Spike de Raph et du Tritonateur.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La colère de Tiger Claw
programme.desc: Shredder confie à Tiger Claw la mission de détruire les tortues. Karai doit leur tendre un piège. Elle réussit à convaincre April qu'elle est du côté des tortues.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête de pizza
programme.desc: Changement de propriétaire chez Antonio, le roi des pizzas. Le nouveau chef est un mutant, à tête de pizza. Tous les clients qui consomment ses créations sont changés en zombies, destinés à finir roulés en calzone dans l'estomac du mutant.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La légende du Kuro Kabuto
programme.desc: Steranko, un obscur marchand d'armes borgne, est à la recherche d'un objet qui viendra compléter sa collection d'armures. Il s'agit du « Kuro Kabuto », le casque de Shredder.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Plan 10
programme.desc: Les Krangs testent une nouvelle machine pour envahir la Terre, qui consiste à permuter les cerveaux. Ils pourront ainsi manœuvrer les leaders terriens et parvenir à leurs fins.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le goût de la vengeance
programme.desc: Karai est enfermée dans les prisons de Shredder. Les tortues la font évader et la ramènent au repaire. Splinter lui explique l'histoire de la guerre entre le Clan des Foot et la famille Hamato.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le fantôme de Chinatown
programme.desc: Pendant qu'ils cherchent Karaï, les tortues croisent les Dragons Pourpres qui paraissent beaucoup plus forts qu'à l'accoutumée. En effet, un mystérieux esprit sorti d'une dague les a dotés de pouvoirs. L'un maîtrise la foudre ; l'autre, le tonnerre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Voyage dans la Dimension X

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion - partie 1

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion - partie 2

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Writing your own name in graffiti all over the school wouldn't be very smart, right? Binky says he didn't do it, so detectives Fern and Buster are on the case. Then, Binky is the newest, hottest, hippest pop music craze in Elwood City.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Woogles have their own names and personalities and they're so darned cute! And Arthur's gotta have one, especially now that everyone is collecting them. Arthur wouldn't mind if Dad's infamous dessert "experiments" remained a family secret.
programme.sub-title: Arthur Rides The Bandwagon/Dad's Dessert Dilemma

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Sue Ellen and Fern take a popularity quiz in a magazine and change their personalities to become more likable, but it backfires. And Buster's convinced that his great joke will be the difference between a successful oral report and failure.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Buster digs up an ancient arrowhead, everyone else wants to hunt for buried treasures, too. And a field trip to the Medieval Fair pits Arthur's class against another led by Ratburn's super-tough mentor, Mr. Pryce-Jones.
programme.sub-title: Arthur's Treasure Hunt/The Return Of The King

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: If you think the Tibbles are bad now, imagine what they'd be like if they had super powers! Then, D.W. needs money, quick. When she tries to pull a fast one on the Tooth Fairy, will Arthur have to pay?
programme.sub-title: Attack Of The Turbo Tibbles/D.W. Tricks The Tooth Fairy

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Playing with the Tibble twins requires preparation, endurance and earplugs. But when one gets sick, playing with the other should be a lot easier, right? Arthur and the gang create their own music videos.
programme.sub-title: Double Tibble Trouble/Arthur's Almost Live Not Real Music Festival

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Sue Ellen's not afraid of much, but when she encounters a really creepy howling noise in the woods, she's scared for real. Then, Grandma Thora has a lot of fun stuff, especially her porcelain doll, Clarissa.
programme.sub-title: What Scared Sue Ellen?/Clarissa Is Cracked

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When painfully shy George brings a ventriloquist dummy to school, a popular kid is born! Then, Arthur thinks the best pet to have is a dog, and Francine probably would have agreed--that is, until little Nemo, a cute kitten, came along.
programme.sub-title: Arthur's Dummy Disaster/Francine and The Feline

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Mom and Dad fight over spilled milk, Arthur and D.W. fear the worst. Is it Arthur's fault or D.W.'s? Then, turning five is a major, big deal event! But D.W. worries that she fribbled away her preschool years on meaningless pursuits.
programme.sub-title: Mom and Dad Have A Great Big Fight/D.W.'s Perfect Wish

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur just might make it to Happy Crazy Wow Day at the park--if he and D.W. can work together to clean their rooms! Then, Arthur and the gang realize they are suffering from the January doldrums brought on by an acute lack of holidays.
programme.sub-title: Arthur and D.W. Clean Up/The Long, Dull Winter

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When D.W. discovers that she can get her own library card, she rejoices at the world of books waiting for her. And, is it ever okay to hit someone? Sometimes you just get so mad, you wanna....pow! Right??

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The kids capture a snake and learn that it's possibly poisonous--after it gets lost in Arthur's house! Why is Muffy interviewing for a new best friend? She and Francine are usually inseparable, but lately it seems they have less in common.
programme.sub-title: Hide And Snake/Muffy's New Best Friend

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Will Buster's friends treat him the same after they learn he has asthma? Prankster have arrived in Elwood City--just in time for the "Scare Your Pants Off" costume party! It's boys vs. girls in what becomes a great big battle of the pranks.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: What would happen if Arthur and his friends entered a contest to write stories for their favorite TV show? Then, look out world, D.W. has discovered science! But D.W.'s new-found passion proves that a little knowledge is a dangerous thing.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: A blizzard comes to town, taking out the electricity and sending residents scrambling for supplies. Can neighbors find ways to help each other survive through the storm? Then, the unthinkable is happening...Arthur's teacher is moving in!
programme.sub-title: The Blizzard/The Rat Who Came To Dinner

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: What happens when you combine Greek Mythology with D.W.'s imagination? Then, getting two Polly Locket dolls almost ruins Prunella's birthday party. That, and Francine's bad mood--why, she wouldn't even sing the Happy Birthday song!
programme.sub-title: D.W. Tale Spins/Prunella Gets It Twice

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Does Binky have a favorite pastime? Not until citywide Bug Week, when suddenly all he can think about is butterflies. Then, there's a horrible racket in Elwood City, and it's Francine practicing her singing and drumming for the Talent Show!
programme.sub-title: Binky Barnes, Wingman/To Beat Or Not To Beat

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Buster insists that he will miss the Father's Day picnic because he has other plans, Arthur is convinced that he's really sad and embarrassed about his parents’ divorce. And Prunella predicts a gift of flashpants, the hot new fashion.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur and friends are all faced with seemingly impossible tasks, from fixing a model biplane to babysitting D.W. And, Buster knows he's fun, but he's beginning to feel like he's not particularly good at anything.
programme.sub-title: What Is That Thing?/Buster's Best Behavior

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: It's the duel of the century as cellist Yo-Yo Ma faces jazz saxophonist Joshua Redman in the toughest gig of their careers at the Elwood City Library! Then, will Arthur be exposed as a baby show lover?
programme.sub-title: My Music Rules/That's A Baby Show!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Alex Trebek lends his voice as gameshow host Alex Lebek in this episode which poses the age-old riddle--is winning really everything? What if your friends dared you to skip homework--and then double dared you to skip school?
programme.sub-title: Arthur And The Big Riddle/Double Dare

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: It’s Lakewood Elementary Parents Open House! How will the kids survive a whole evening of their parents' embarrassing antics? Buster is the only kid in Elwood City who doesn't have a Cybertoy, so he decides to 'borrow' one from the store.
programme.sub-title: Kids Are From Earth, Parents Are From Pluto/Nerves Of Steal

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Why is Buster walking backwards and Muffy not talking? They're trying to set world records of course! Then, Arthur thinks his class trip to the Clark Caves will be really cool--but won't it be dark in there?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: An army of lice has descended on the heads of Lakewood Elementary. Who or what is strong enough to defeat them? What if you could be Arthur for a day? View Arthur's life through his very own eyes for this special episode.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: There’s a mock election in Mr. Ratburn's class, but Muffy takes it seriously. How far will she go to win? Francine can't believe it. She gets in trouble no matter what she does -- thanks to the new nosy next-door neighbor!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Buster is convinced that Pizza Paula's all-you-can-eat contest is his destiny. But how can he possibly win such an important contest without any sleep? Binky volunteers to look after Francine's cat, Nemo, for the weekend.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Mary Moo Cow is cancelled, D.W. is devastated. How can television--or life as she knows it--ever be the same? Buster hasn't yet met Bitzi's new boyfriend, but he fears the worst. What if he is a Mom-stealer?
programme.sub-title: The Last of Mary Moo Cow/Bitzi's Beau

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur has a hard time resisting sweets, and one evening his overindulgence wins him an upset stomach and some 'Grimm' dreams. Arthur and D.W. loved it when Grandpa Dave came to visit--but now he only wants to sleep and play checkers.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Sue Ellen is the champion of the popular Internet game, Virtualgoose.com, but she’s become obsessed! And now the gang has moved onto Best of the Nest. Will any of his friends be willing to forgo their computers for a real, live adventure?
programme.sub-title: Sue Ellen Gets Her Goose Cooked/Best of The Nest

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur's beloved piano teacher is retiring, but she assures him that the new teacher is outstanding--and famous, too! When Buster signs up to sell candy for the band, he figures it's easy money -- who doesn't love chocolate?
programme.sub-title: Arthur Plays The Blues/Buster's Sweet Success

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The latest book about everyone's favorite boy wizard--Henry Skreever--is finally out! Every kid in town is lining up to get it, except Prunella, who's ordered a limited edition from England. Ever wonder what Baby Kate and Pal are thinking?
programme.sub-title: Prunella's Special Edition/The Secret Life Of Dogs & Babies

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Muffy's proud that her dad is the new soccer coach--until he exhausts the team with demanding drills. The try-outs for the Young Person's Orchestra are coming to Lakewood Elementary and everyone agrees that Binky is a shoe-in.
programme.sub-title: Muffy's Soccer Shocker/Brother, Can You Spare A Clarinet?

programme.title: Draft Day
programme.desc: On the day of the NFL draft, the general manager of the Cleveland Browns must decide what he's willing to sacrifice as he angles for the number-one pick.

programme.title: American Hustle
programme.desc: An ambitious FBI agent (Bradley Cooper) forces a con man (Christian Bale) and his partner (Amy Adams) to infiltrate the dangerous but seductive world of New Jersey's power-brokers and crime syndicates.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: A post-apocalyptic ice age forces humanity's last survivors aboard a globe-spanning supertrain. One man will risk everything to lead a revolt for control of the engine and the future of the world.

programme.title: A Single Man
programme.desc: Planning to commit suicide at the end of the day, a gay professor (Colin Firth) who recently lost his lover goes about his daily routine and visits with longtime friends.

programme.title: Carol
programme.desc: Aspiring photographer Therese spots the beautiful, elegant Carol perusing the doll displays in a 1950s Manhattan department store. The two women develop a fast bond that becomes a love with complicated consequences.

programme.title: Anna Karenina
programme.desc: A 19th-century Russian aristocrat (Keira Knightley) faces a difficult decision when her husband (Jude Law) finds out about her scandalous affair with a dashing cavalry officer (Aaron Taylor-Johnson).

programme.title: The Final Cut
programme.desc: A man (Robin Williams) who assembles films from people's memory chips finds a connection to his own darkest secret in the footage from a dead executive.

programme.title: The Grudge
programme.desc: An American nurse living and working in Tokyo is exposed to a mysterious curse, one that locks a person in a powerful rage before claiming their life and spreading to another victim.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Families are devastated when children go missing, but oftentimes it is a parental abduction. Fifteen years ago, John Clark came home from work to find his wife and three children gone, leaving only a cryptic note saying they went on vacation. Part 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil's guests say they endure abuse from their grown children. Debbie says daughter, Amy, 31, is verbally & physically abusive. Amy admits she can be cruel to her mom, but Debbie makes her feel like a failure. As tempers flare see who storms off!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues discussions with Tommy, ex-wife, Julia & new husband, Codey, over the deaths of 19-month-old Darby & 4-year-old Kiera. Dr. Phil enlists forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht to examine the autopsy reports. Polygraph tests are offered.
programme.sub-title: Parents Accused Of Murder: Will Julia and Codey Agree To Take The Polygraph Test? Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tom and Karen say Madison, 15, is out of control. Tom has served seven tours of duty in the Middle East commanding troops but says he's faced his scariest and most dangerous enemy in his own home. Fearing for their lives, they need Dr. Phil’s help. Part 1
programme.sub-title: Police Called 100 Times On Our Car Stealing, Drug Taking, Dad Beating, Beautiful 15-Year-Old Daughter, Who Is Now Corrupting Her Younger Sister Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues with pregnant teen, Sara, who says she’s not addicted--her sister is a bad influence. Dr. Phil learns she and sister Sadie did cocaine the night before the show. Dr. Phil shows video of addicted babies and issues an ultimatum. Part 2
programme.sub-title: Pregnant And Abusing Drugs: The Ultimatum Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Kristin says she’s desperate for an intervention for her daughter, Sara, 18, seven months pregnant who admits to smoking cigarettes and marijuana daily and using cocaine and heroin. Drug test results, plus Dr. Phil uncovers shocking childhood details. Par
programme.sub-title: Pregnant And Out Of Control: Will The Baby Be Born Addicted Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Warren Jeffs, leader of the Fundamentalist Church of Jesus Christ of Latter Day Saints & self-proclaimed prophet, was on the FBI's 10 Most Wanted Fugitives for unlawful flight & sexual conduct with a minor. Dr. Phil talks with FLDS member Willie Jessop.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil welcomes controversial YouTuber "Agent Sebastian" who runs a page called "Cart Narcs" posting hundreds of explosive videos apprehending shoppers in parking lots who do not return their carts to the corrals. Is "Agent Sebastian" breaking the law?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Lorie says husband, Dan, knew she placed a baby for adoption when she was 15 & he always supported her finding him. Dan says after reuniting with son, John, 26, family life shattered. Dan says he believes Lorie & John have an inappropriate relationship.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How well do you know your teenager? Could your child be participating in risky or illegal activities right under your own roof?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Many women are itching to run to the altar, but Dr. Phil's guests say they are ready to run for the hills! Meet Kelly, who calls herself a runaway bride, and Chad, who says weddings are too expensive. Can Dr. Phil get them to commit?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mom Jessica says husband Mike is a controlling narcissist. Chloe, 16, & Zoey, 18, say dad shattered their dancing dreams. Mike says Jessica puts the girls in the middle. Dr. Phil tells mom & dad what couples need to do with children as a marriage ends.
programme.sub-title: Save My Beautiful Daughters From Their Narcissistic Father

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: McKinley, 18, says she decided 5 years ago she never wanted to see her dad, Cory, again, after learning he went to jail on two counts of sexual battery of a minor! She says her dad is a violent, dangerous, "psychopath". Cory says he's never abused anyone.
programme.sub-title: Sex Abuse Allegations Ruined My Run For Congress And My Relationship With My Daughter Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Marie says husband Ron has a violent temper & she fears her safety & of their 4-yr-old. She alleges Ron pushed her down the stairs & wrote "kill" on a bathroom mirror. Ron says Marie mixes her meds with alcohol. Dr. Phil cameras record the chaos at home.
programme.sub-title: Shocking Accusations: Abused Wife Or Abused Husband?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you constantly have to compromise to get along with your mate? Do you feel like you have to give up a vital part of yourself to be in a relationship? Dr. Phil talks to controlling guests, and the loved ones who feel trapped by them.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: There have been no answers to the whereabouts of Summer Wells, 5, missing since 2021. Parents Don & Candus say it backfired by requesting the public's help. In this exclusive first national TV interview, Dr. Phil digs deeper into the story.
programme.sub-title: Summer Wells Disappearance: What Do The Parents Know? Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: For the past 2 years Nancy has been in an online relationship with "Shaun" she says is an honest and loving man. Her son Darcy says Nancy doesn't even know what he looks like! Nancy is adamant she is not being scammed in this catfish story of online love.
programme.sub-title: Talk To Dr. Phil Or We're Done Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Blaze et les Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze et ses amis participent à une course de nuit. L'expérience se complique lorsqu'une petite voleuse de lumières s'amuse à voler tous les projecteurs qui éclairent la piste.

programme.title: Top Wing, Toutes ailes dehors !
programme.desc: La Team Top Wing aide Della et l'ours aventurier dans les grottes des dodos et risque d'y être enfermée. // La team Top Wing doit sauver les concurrents de la grande course du Colossal Splash .
programme.sub-title: Survivor Bear and the Secret of Ker-Splash Canyon / Great Ker-Splash Race

programme.title: Top Wing, Toutes ailes dehors !
programme.desc: La Team Top Wing doit retrouver Earl pour qu'il répare une machine devenue hors de contrôle. // L'inspecteur Coup d'œil veut séparer les élèves officiers et les envoyer dans des centres d'entraînement différents.
programme.sub-title: Earl's Nutty Invention / Big Swirl Break-Up

programme.title: Top Wing, Toutes ailes dehors !
programme.desc: Les Officiers débutants ont une mission d'entraînement: sauver les citrons de Rhonda. // En cherchant des coquillages, Brody tombe par hasard sur une carte au trésor.
programme.sub-title: Junior Cadets Rescue / Sunken Treasure Race

programme.title: Top Wing, Toutes ailes dehors !
programme.desc: Des ours polaires dérivent en pleine mer, mais Penny et ses amis vont tout faire pour les sauver.

programme.title: Dora l'exploratrice
programme.desc: Dora garde les chatons de sa grand-mère partie en vacances. Elle rêve que Lucky, le coquin de la bande a disparu en chassant une pelote de ficelle. Aide Dora à rembobiner la ficelle et à retrouver Lucky.

programme.title: Dora l'exploratrice
programme.desc: Dora a une méga surprise pour Puppy, mais Chipeur essaie d'être le premier à la récupérer. Retrouvez Dora, Babouche et Puppy aidés de leurs autres amis et animaux pour une nouvelle aventure !

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Piège puissance quatre
programme.desc: À l'aide des Mascottes de Baxter Stockman, Karaï parvient à attirer les tortues une à une. Elle veut ainsi pousser Splinter à l'affronter en duel. Mais son plan machiavélique ne s'arrête pas là...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Un dinosaure dans les égouts !
programme.desc: La légende urbaine de l'homme-dinosaure, sur laquelle enquêtait Kurtzman, rattrape Doc Rockwell et Slash dans les égouts de New York. Ces derniers sont mis K.O. par une créature étrange, et Raphaël est appelé à la rescousse pour la neutraliser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'anéantissement de la Terre (1/2)
programme.desc: Les tortues rencontrent le mystérieux Bishop, qui signe ses messages d'une pièce d'échecs (le fou, pour Bishop). Il leur apprend que la Terre est doublement menacée par les Krangs qui ont enfin réparé leur Technodrome.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'anéantissement de la Terre (2/2)
programme.desc: Les tortues et tous leurs alliés (Slash et les mutanimaux, Mondo Gecko, Muckman) tentent d'empêcher les Tricératons d'activer le générateur de trou noir et d'aspirer la Terre. En vain. Le capitaine Mozar kidnappe Mikey et l'emmène dans l'espace.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Au-delà des frontières de l'espace
programme.desc: Les tortues ont embarqué pour un voyage sidéral sur le vaisseau du Fugitoïde. Elles partent à la recherche du vaisseau amiral des Tricératons après un bond Tachyonique qui leur a permis de changer d'époque.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les lunes de Thalos 3
programme.desc: Les tortues percutent le vaisseau des Salamandres et atterrissent en catastrophe sur une planète recouverte de glace de méthane. Elles doivent de toute urgence récupérer de l'irrilium pour réparer leur vaisseau.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le monde selon Wyrm
programme.desc: En visitant la carcasse d'un vaisseau spatial, Casey découvre une boîte mystérieuse et la ramène à bord. Le fugitoïde explique qu'il s'agit d'un hypercube renfermant des créatures de la cinquième dimension.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le chasseur de primes
programme.desc: Lord Dregg envoie Armaggon, un requin chasseur de primes, traquer les tortues. Celles-ci se réfugient dans une station spatiale abandonnée, dirigée par Omni-Intel, un ordinateur de bord qui entend se débarrasser de tous les êtres vivants.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'énigme des Anciens Eons
programme.desc: Le fugitoïde stationne le vaisseau près d'une planète où les Tricératons pensent tenir le premier fragment du générateur de trou noir. Il a bien l'intention de les prendre de vitesse, mais tout ne se passe pas comme prévu...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Voyage au centre de l'esprit de Mikey
programme.desc: Le fugitoïde rencontre un informateur nommé Vrax Belebome qui détiendrait les plans du vaisseau amiral des Tricératons. Ce dernier prend l'argent de fugitoïde, mais il refuse de donner les précieuses informations en échange.
programme.sub-title: Voyage au centre de l'esprit de Mikey

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'arène du carnage
programme.desc: Les tortues arrivent à s'introduire dans le vaisseau amiral des Tricératons. Mais elles sont faites prisonnières et deviennent des gladiateurs dans l'arène Tricératon.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Bataille pour la Dimension X
programme.desc: Sal et Mona tentent de s'allier avec Krang Second pour combattre les Tricératons. Krang Second les jette en prison. Les tortues sont à la recherche des autres fragments du générateur de trou noir.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'océan cosmique
programme.desc: Les tortues partent à la recherche du deuxième fragment que les Outromes ont confié aux Dagones Celles-ci vivent dans un royaume sous-marin, dans l'océan cosmique de Varuna.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les tortues transdimensionnelles
programme.desc: Alors que les tortues s'apprêtent à partir chercher le dernier morceau du générateur de trou noir, elles sont happées dans un univers parallèle, celui des tortues ninja du dessin animé de 1987.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La vengeance des Tricératons
programme.desc: Les Tricératons ont suivi la trace du vaisseau Ulysse. Ils lancent un ultimatum à son équipage : soit ils leur remettent les fragments, soit ils se font anéantir.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Dregg le maléfique
programme.desc: Les tortues captent un signal de détresse. C'est Mona, qui leur apprend que son commandant Sal a été capturé par Armaggon sur l'ordre de Dregg.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le feu éternel
programme.desc: Direction l'autre bout du cosmos, vers une galaxie au nom à rallonge, ZZ-Trois-Pluriel-X-Bêta, et plus particulièrement la planète Magdomar qui abrite selon les Outromes le troisième et dernier fragment du générateur de trou noir.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Ultime chance pour la Terre
programme.desc: Le compte à rebours est lancé avant la mise en route du générateur de trou noir par les Tricératons pour aspirer la planète Terre. Il reste peu de temps aux tortues pour empêcher ces derniers de réduire la planète à néant.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La guerre des clans
programme.desc: Retour dans un New York tranquille. Cérémonie pour April, organisée par Splinter. Elle est désormais kunoïchi. Mais le soir même, une mystérieuse sorcière lui vole son tanto du dragon.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Foot contre Foot
programme.desc: Leonardo a fait alliance en cachette avec Karaï et Shinigami pour démanteler une à une les opérations de Shredder. Ils commencent par une planque des Dragons Pourpres, puis s'attaquent à l'usine chimique, un lieu névralgique de l'organisation.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Infectes insectes
programme.desc: Stockman crée de nouveaux mutants pour l'aider à cambrioler les banques afin de réunir de l'argent pour Shredder. Un ancien homme d'affaires devient Scaramouche, un mutant mi-araignée mi-mouche. Il crée également une fourmi géante.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les mutants contre-attaquent
programme.desc: Don Vizioso veut prendre le contrôle de la ville. Pour cela, il doit se débarrasser des mutants présents dans la ville de New York.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Une chauve-souris dans le beffroi
programme.desc: Mikey, Leo et Raph se disputent au sujet de leur BD préférée. Pour Mikey, Bat-Boulon et Écrou Kid sont au-dessus du panier. Leo préfère l'Homme-araignée, Supérieur-Man, ou encore l'Invincible Bossu. Pour Raph, il n'y a pas photo.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Super Shredder
programme.desc: Shredder absorbe du mutagène et devient Super Shredder. Il capture Karai pour attirer Splinter dans un piège et en finir avec son ennemi juré. Mais Splinter lit clair dans son jeu et le piège à son tour.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Au fond du trou
programme.desc: Tandis que Donnie et Mikey partent explorer le gouffre à la recherche de Splinter, Leo, April et Karai affrontent Super Shredder. Karaï trouve son point faible : son cœur protubérant. Mais le méchant s'échappe à temps.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Cette force en elle
programme.desc: April a une conduite de plus en plus étrange. Elle est possédée par un ancien Eon, Za-Noran, par l'intermédiaire de son cristal. Les tortues décident de détruire la pierre pour sauver leur amie.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tokka contre le reste du monde
programme.desc: Quand Tokka décide de récupérer son petit, c'est le branle-bas de combat sur Terre. Les Forces de Protection Terriennes décident d'attaquer malgré les mises en garde de Bishop.
programme.sub-title: Tokka contre le reste du monde

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La légende de Tiger Claw
programme.desc: Tiger Claw et sa sœur Alopex ont été enlevés enfants par les Krangs. Le tigre et la renarde sont devenus ennemis. Alopex vole les lames de la vengeance dans un musée pour détruire son frère.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Requiem
programme.desc: Super Shredder teste un nouveau super mutagène concocté par Stockman-mouche, qui se révèle parfait pour sa prochaine mission : exterminer tous ses ennemis sans exception, et sans empathie.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La fin
programme.desc: Les tortues rendent visite à Karaï à l'hôpital. Elle leur révèle où se trouve la planque de Super Shredder. Il s'agit d'une forteresse high-tech en pleine forêt, défendue par ses footbots et autres sergents.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le rouleau du Démodragon
programme.desc: Les tortues enquêtent sur une mystérieuse secte qui se réunit dans les égoûts. Tiger Claw a décidé de ressusciter Super Shredder.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'épéiste oublié
programme.desc: Tiger Claw ordonne à Kavaxas de ramener Rahzar à la vie, ce qu'il parvient à faire. Il lui dit de reproduire ce prodige avec Shredder. Mais il lui manque un élément essentiel, le Kuro Kabuto.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le cœur du démon
programme.desc: Kavaxas a besoin du cœur de Shredder pour le ressusciter. C'est Don Vizioso qui s'en est emparé et qui le conserve dans une fiole. Les tortues et Tiger Claw vont tout faire pour le lui reprendre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La fin des temps
programme.desc: Shredder prend le pouvoir et détruit le sceau. Kavaxas est libre, il ouvre le portail du Royaume des Ténèbres et les revenants déferlent sur Terre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Il était une fois Splinter et les tortues...
programme.desc: Maître Splinter réunit ses quatre fils, pas encore adolescents. Il leur raconte en détail la genèse de leur histoire, et leurs débuts dans les rues hostiles de New York.
programme.sub-title: Il était une fois Splinter et les tortues...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La malédiction de Savanti Romero
programme.desc: Panique le soir d'Halloween : New York est envahi de vrais zombies, vampires et loups-garous. April et Casey sont contaminés.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La crypte de Dracula
programme.desc: Les tortues veulent tuer Dracula avant que Savanti ne s'en empare. Mais Raph est transformé en vampire et Savanti s'enfuit, emportant avec lui la momie, un loup-garou (le père d'Esméralda), Raph et Dracula.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La créature du docteur Frankenstein
programme.desc: Les tortues ninja partent en Allemagne en 1818 pour tenter d'arrêter Savanti Roméro, qui veut engager Frankenstein dans son armée. Ils échouent mais grace à Reinette les tortues retournent dans le futur pour une dernière tentative.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les monstres attaquent
programme.desc: La ville de New York est envahie par des monstres en tous genres. Les tortues, aidées de Reinette, tentent de déjouer le plan de Savanti Romero et de Dracula.

programme.title: iCarly: Le bêtisier d'iCarly
programme.desc: Miranda, l'actrice qui joue le rôle d'iCarly convoque Jerry, le comédien jouant Spencer sur le plateau pour lui remonter les bretelles.

programme.title: iCarly: L'anniversaire de Carly
programme.desc: C'est l'anniversaire de Carly, Spencer veut lui faire un cadeau original. Il fabrique une lampe avec des bonbons qui prend feu. La chambre de Carly brûle entièrement. Grâce à l'argent de l'assurance,

programme.title: iCarly: Je le veux
programme.desc: Carly reçoit une demande originale : Gordon, un fan de l'émission, veut demander la main de sa petite amie, Jodi, en direct. Jodi accepte la demande en mariage et convie Carly et ses amis au mariage!

programme.title: iCarly: Les Blaguo-shirts
programme.desc: Sam et Carly organisent une vente aux enchères avec tout un tas d'objets qui leur ont servi pendant l'émission iCarly. Le t-shirt rigolo remporte un succès.

programme.desc: Carly n'a jamais fait de blague et demande à Spencer de l'aider. Il fini par accepter, mais ses vieux démons le rattrapent. Lorsqu'il était en troisième, on l'appelait le roi de la blague, jusqu'au jour où.

programme.title: iCarly: Sam et sa mère

programme.title: iCarly: Le stagiaire

programme.title: iCarly: En couple avec Sam et Freddie
programme.desc: Sam et Freddie sortent ensemble pour la plus grande joie de Carly qui est ravie de voir ses deux amis amoureux après s'être détestés toutes ces années.

programme.desc: Sam et Freddie sortent ensemble pour la plus grande joie de Carly qui est ravie de voir ses deux amis amoureux après s'être détestés toutes ces années.

programme.title: Mammon

programme.title: Mammon

programme.title: Mammon

programme.title: Stockholm Requiem

programme.title: Stockholm Requiem
programme.desc: La police pense dans un premier temps que le meurtre du couple est lié à une organisation criminelle et au meurtre de réfugiés. Une découverte révèle une piste de cupidité et de trahison qui a déchiré des familles et des vies.

programme.title: Stockholm Requiem
programme.desc: Lorsque deux garçons juifs sont enlevés alors qu'ils se rendaient à la pratique religieuse, leurs parents se disputent pour savoir où se trouve vraiment le blâme. Fredrika est enceinte de sept mois, mais son bonheur est gâché par le nouveau cas.

programme.title: Stockholm Requiem
programme.desc: Une légende israélienne raconte l'histoire du Paper Boy qui s'anime la nuit et prend ses victimes. Ce qui semble initialement être un crime de haine raciste semble être lié à ce mythe. Il est de nouveau vivant et veut se venger

programme.sub-title: Louis et les amoureux du manège

programme.title: Louis la Brocante: Louis et la prison de cristal

programme.sub-title: Louis et la prison de cristal

programme.title: Louis la Brocante: Louis et les larmes de la Vierge
